device.description: selected device. Returns statistic for the current device, given by :func:`~torch.cuda.current_device`, if :attr:`device` is ``None`` (default).
constraints: device type must be one of: torch.device, str, int, or None

output.description: Return the average temperature of the GPU sensor in Degrees C (Centigrades).

constraints: Each sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second, depending on the product being queried.
